details: The package contains no linter functionality despite its name; it consists of a single 445-byte index.js wired to a postinstall hook ("node index.js"). On install it reads the local account name via os.userInfo().username and the machine name via os.hostname(), serialises them as {"p":"regex-linter","u":<username>,"h":<hostname>} and POSTs that JSON to hxxps://nathanaccacio[.]com/collect over HTTPS, discarding any error so the install completes silently. No credentials, environment values, tokens or files are read, and no additional code is downloaded or executed. The collection endpoint nathanaccacio[.]com/collect is the sole network indicator.
